comment: The functional checklist of the garage brief (round 4), the same for the HTML and the Nyra version. check.js reads it. Every item is derived from a requirement of the brief; the method section of results/2026-10-20/REPORT.md says how each kind is checked. The texts of the service tab panels are checked by the tabs item (a page may only show or even only add a panel once its tab is selected); the calculator's prices and totals by the calculator item. The calculator steps avoid the brief's example total (3,080).
